reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "MTU auto-detection will now use the lowest MTU of all external interfaces", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: behavior-change

consequence.statement: Environments using auto-detection will now select the lowest MTU across all external interfaces instead of only the primary interface, which may result in lower MTU values being applied.
consequence.remediation: If the change in MTU value is not desired, configure MTU manually via the MTU helm option, --mtu agent flag, or mtu option in CNI configuration.

proposed.statement: MTU auto-detection behavior changes to use the lowest MTU of all external interfaces instead of only the primary interface, except in ENI mode.
